title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to hide/disable New, Edit (Edit List), and Delete actions on the page
summary: This post explains two methods to hide or disable the New, Edit (Edit List), and Delete actions in Business Central pages: using permission sets to exclude Insert, Modify, and Delete permissions, or setting the InsertAllowed, ModifyAllowed, and DeleteAllowed properties (available in BC25 wave 2 for page extensions).
key_points: Special actions like New, Edit, and Delete are not defined in AL code but correspond directly to Insert, Modify, and Delete permissions in Table Data
Permission exclusion hides actions by graying them out for list pages, but errors occur when users click grayed-out actions in dropdown lists
InsertAllowed, ModifyAllowed, and DeleteAllowed properties can hide these actions completely on custom pages and from BC25 on standard pages via extensions
For list pages with card pages, restrict the card page properties; for list pages without card pages, modify the list page directly
Dropdown list restrictions require identifying which card page opens and modifying its properties instead

quotes.text: These three actions correspond to the following three permissions of Table Data: New: Insert Permission, Edit (Edit List): Modify Permission, Delete: Delete Permission.
quotes.why_it_matters: It explains the fundamental mapping between UI actions and permission system, essential for understanding both control methods

quotes.text: From Business Central 2024 wave 2 (BC25), we can modify these three properties in pageextension.
quotes.why_it_matters: This marks a significant capability change that enables hiding these actions on standard pages without custom code on the page itself
